title: Shape optimisation of nonlinear Naghdi shells on discrete geometries
summary: A thin shell carries load through its shape and, at finite deflections, its stiffness changes with the load itself, so a shape optimum found with a linear model can be far from optimal. We present an automated framework that embeds the fully geometrically nonlinear shell response in the shape-optimisation loop. The forward model, a five-parameter nonlinear Naghdi shell stabilised against locking by partial selective reduced integration, operates directly on a discrete (faceted) triangulation with a numerically recovered director field -- dispensing with the exact mid-surface parameterisation…
